review_method: Independent assistant reading of selected public inputs and recorded adopted source-base metadata; no model output was used to choose cases or expected behaviour. Witnesses are schedule/resource proposals, not publisher-certified training prescriptions.
authority_and_acceptance: This review recommends use as provisional development diagnostics. It records no human or second-teammate approval and does not satisfy the original accepted-study-profile review contract.
global_findings: All ten feasible-intent cases have two private 15-minute slot proposals inside stated availability and extra-time limits, with no overlap against listed commitments. This arithmetic does not prove complete-week or activity-content suitability.

Three rectangle/defensive or direction-change witnesses need stationary partner and ball-path layout review; three shooting/decision witnesses lack source completion-time evidence; four timed individual/paired witnesses have stronger listed-resource support.

The three participant-count cases and one missing existing-schedule case have explicit essential gaps; two zero-minute-budget conflicts and three scope exclusions are clear. The daily-training conflict has broad wording and should permit clarification.

The original records lack public schedule completeness. If a new fictional version adds schedule_coverage to all twenty cases, record authorship and both hashes; keep the unknown-existing-schedule case false/unknown. Do not treat non-null as evidence of completeness.

Witnesses, intended categories and expected behaviours remain private; the model receives only the common public version. Do not penalize model-alone activities for failing to cite a hidden catalogue ID.
Adopted practice-length guidance is advisory. Short extra sessions are not invalid solely because they fall below the advisory practice-length range.
Six explicit food questions are retained; actual local lookup output, food identity, nutrient identity, units and quantity must be saved before numeric correctness can be scored.
